component_modals_opened.recalc_check: 0.02591 kg/(t*mi) x 213.35135 t x 2199 mi = 12,155.5 kg = 12.156 tCO2e = Certify displayed value EXACT MATCH. Methodology note: this component uses TOTAL combined mass x the FULL single-leg distance (not the allocated/fractional 6,019.85mi datapoint), which is mathematically identical to summing (per-railcar mass share x 2199mi) across all 4 railcars, since every railcar physically traverses the same complete 2199mi leg regardless of partial/full offload status. The Allocated Distance datapoint (6,019.85mi) is instead used for the EMBODIED component (verified: 6,019.85mi x 0.0000311307 MTCO2e/mi = 0.1874 t = Certify's displayed 0.187t EXACT MATCH) -- embodied amortizes the railcar ASSET's manufacturing footprint proportional to this batch's fractional share of each trip, which is a different physical basis than process (fuel) emissions. Both are internally consistent and correct.
